name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefit_hi: पात्र किसान परिवारों के लिए आय सहायता।
eligibility: Check current exclusion rules and status on the official portal.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit_hi: फसल बीमा के आवेदन और दावा सेवाएँ।
eligibility: Crop, season, district and enrolment windows vary; check the official portal.
docs: See current insurer and season requirements

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit_hi: भागीदार बैंकों से खेती के लिए ऋण सुविधा।
eligibility: Bank and borrower rules apply; check official scheme guidance.
docs: Bank application and current identity/land or tenancy proof as applicable

name: Soil Health Card
benefit: Laboratory-based soil nutrient status and recommendations.
benefit_hi: लैब जाँच पर आधारित मिट्टी के पोषक तत्व और सलाह।
eligibility: Check soil sample and card services in your district.
docs: Ask the local soil laboratory for sample requirements

name: e-NAM
benefit: Access to electronic agricultural market services in linked mandis.
benefit_hi: जुड़ी हुई मंडियों में ऑनलाइन कृषि बाजार सेवाएँ।
eligibility: Check whether your mandi and commodity are supported.

name: PM-KUSUM
benefit: Solar agriculture pump and related components through state agencies.
benefit_hi: राज्य एजेंसियों के माध्यम से सौर कृषि पंप और संबंधित सहायता।
eligibility: State implementation and component rules apply; check the official national portal.
docs: See your state agency's current application documents

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
benefit: Farm machinery assistance and custom hiring services where offered.
benefit_hi: जहाँ उपलब्ध हो, कृषि मशीनों और किराये की सेवाओं में सहायता।
eligibility: State targets and application windows vary; check the official portal.
docs: See your state's current machinery application requirements

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
benefit: Irrigation and water-use programmes under different components.
benefit_hi: सिंचाई और पानी के बेहतर उपयोग से जुड़ी योजनाएँ।
eligibility: Component and state implementation vary; check the official portal.
docs: See the responsible component and state office

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
benefit: Financing facility for eligible agriculture infrastructure projects.
benefit_hi: पात्र कृषि बुनियादी ढाँचे के लिए वित्त सुविधा।
eligibility: Project and financing criteria apply; review current guidance.
docs: See the official portal and participating lender requirements

name: National Mission on Natural Farming
benefit: Natural-farming support through participating state programmes.
benefit_hi: भागीदार राज्यों में प्राकृतिक खेती के लिए सहायता।
eligibility: State and cluster implementation vary; ask your district agriculture office.
docs: Ask your district office for current enrolment requirements
